notesEn: 0.3.64: Backup restore fix — apply.ps1 now writes __backup_manifest.json so settings files restore to their original paths (storages\workspace.json etc.) instead of piling into the DshHome root; old snapshots without the manifest fall back to root with a warning. Failure summary — post-exit prints [X] errors and recent warnings together at the end on push/pull failure. Auto-close — push/pull/update/restore windows now close automatically 6 minutes after showing results (no more press-any-key, which hangs without focus); click × to close early. Boundary: data dirs (workspace/conversations/skills/presets/plugin-data) are not part of config restore.
notes: 0.3.64: 还原备份修复——apply.ps1 备份设置文件时写 __backup_manifest.json，restore.ps1 按清单把 storages\workspace.json 等写回原位（不再堆到 DshHome 根）；无清单老快照退化写回根并告警。失败原因集中展示——推送/拉取失败时 post-exit 末尾集中打印 [X] 错误与最近的 [!] 警告。自动关窗——推送/拉取/更新/还原展示结果 6 分钟后自动退出关窗，不再要求按任意键（无焦点时会卡住），可点 × 提前关。边界：数据目录（workspace/conversations/skills/presets/plugin-data）不纳入配置还原。
